description: This file defines the 'NodeTraverser' class in the Twig templating engine, responsible for traversing nodes within the Twig abstract syntax tree and applying visitor objects to process or modify nodes.

classes.name:
Twig
odeTraverser
classes.description: A class responsible for traversing Twig nodes and applying registered node visitors in sequence.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the NodeTraverser with an environment and optional array of visitors.

methods.name: addVisitor
methods.description: Adds a visitor to the traverser, associating it with a priority.

methods.name: traverse
methods.description: Traverses a node and all its children, applying registered visitors.

methods.name: traverseForVisitor
methods.description: Helper method to traverse a node with a specific visitor, applying enter and leave methods.
